novelty_points.claim: 提出了一种基于图摘要的大规模时序图表示学习方法GSAERU，通过图摘要压缩图快照，结合图自编码器与循环神经网络，高效生成动态时序图的低维表征。
novelty_points.claim_en: Proposed GSAERU, a large-scale sequential graph representation learning method based on graph summarization, which compresses graph snapshots, combines graph autoencoder and recurrent neural network to efficiently generate low-dimensional representations of dynamic sequential graphs.
source_locations: 论文摘要中关于GSAERU的描述
technical_features: 将动态时序图建模为各时刻图快照的序列
利用图摘要技术压缩原图，输入图自编码器
利用重构误差训练节点表征
通过循环神经网络学习时间维度特征与依赖关系
technical_features_en: Modeling dynamic sequential graph as a sequence of graph snapshots at each time step
Compressing original graph via graph summarization and feeding into graph autoencoder
Training node representations using reconstruction error
Learning temporal features and dependencies via recurrent neural network

novelty_points.claim: 提出了一种基于图摘要的分布式图神经网络优化训练算法DSGNN，采用领导者-工作者模式，通过边分割图流划分算法划分图，各工作节点进行基于图摘要的小批量训练，并通过注意力层聚合结果，实现大规模图流数据的快速训练。
novelty_points.claim_en: Proposed DSGNN, a distributed graph neural network optimization training algorithm based on graph summarization, which adopts leader-worker mode, partitions the graph with an edge-based graph flow partitioning algorithm, performs graph summarization-based mini-batch training on workers, and aggregates results through an attention layer, enabling efficient training on large-scale graph streaming data.
source_locations: 论文摘要中关于DSGNN的描述
technical_features: 领导节点利用基于边分割的图流划分算法对原图进行划分并分配给各工作节点
工作节点执行基于图摘要技术的小批量训练
训练结果通过注意力层返回领导节点
领导节点汇总结果并计算梯度，同步更新所有计算节点上的模型
technical_features_en: The leader partitions the original graph using a graph flow partitioning algorithm based on edge segmentation and assigns subgraphs to workers
Workers perform mini-batch training based on graph summarization
Training results are returned to the leader through an attention layer
The leader aggregates results, computes gradients, and synchronously updates models on all computing nodes

novelty_points.claim: 提出了一种基于边分割的图流划分算法，用于大规模图流数据的分布式划分，该算法利用图的边信息进行分割，能够适应图数据的不规则性，实现高效且均衡的子图划分。
novelty_points.claim_en: Proposed an edge-based graph flow partitioning algorithm for distributed partitioning of large-scale graph streaming data, which utilizes graph edge information for segmentation, adapts to the irregularity of graph data, and enables efficient and balanced subgraph partitioning.
source_locations: 论文摘要中关于DSGNN的描述
technical_features: 基于边分割的划分策略
针对图流数据的动态划分
适应图数据的不规则性
用于分布式场景中的子图分配
technical_features_en: Dynamic partitioning for graph streaming data
Adapting to irregularity of graph data
For subgraph assignment in distributed scenarios
